en.hubeali: A group, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Suleyman Al Ja’fary who said,
‘I hear himasws saying: ‘Recite Azān in your house for it would repel the Satanla, and it is recommended for the reason of the children’.
en.sarwar: 35. A group has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Sulayman al-Ja‘fariy who has said the following: “I once heard him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ’Say Adhan in your house; it repels Satan and it is a beloved thing to do for the sake of children.’” (Hadith 34 and 35 are best be explained by fatwa.)
